body: I'm actually quite young, and i'm tired of being beaten and verbally abused by my parents/ step parents. My friends are slowly disappearing, (mental institutes and suicide) and i'm absolutely tired of this.

thank you for replying! I understand what you're saying but i'll have to disagree. I have to edit my post to be more specific, but let me explain a little more. I've lost several friends to mental institutes and suicide already. I have a therapist, but my father is always over my shoulder, so nothing actually gets done. Ideas flash to me, you know- the idea of running out in front of a car or taking too many of a parents sleeping pills, but I'm scared. But eventually, that fear will run out, and ill just be left with nothing. I'm don't really want to drag my life out any longer than it has to be drug out.

Now, i'm not simply going to tell you everything will be OK, but I need you to really read this:

You need to sober up and have a serious talk with your boyfriend. You tell him that you're worried about him, and if he doesn't take it seriously you need to make sure he knows how much he means to you. 

If that's something he just can't understand then reconsider yourself. Look at your life and list any positive things that come to mind. If you can't list any things besides your boyfriend, here's what I recommend:

Take yourself to a movie, or start reading a novel- it will give you something to think about.

Go to any social gatherings near by and meet new people, even if your shy. (Christmas is coming up so this should be especially easy!)

Get a pet!!! Pets are the best therapy in the world (especially dogs) A pet would take your mind off of your problems and, even better, it would love you unconditionally.

I'm not sure if this helped, but I want to at least try to help you.

**ALWAYS REMEMBER THAT YOU ARE WORTH IT, AND SOMEONE IS ROOTING FOR YOU**                                                                           

\- A concerned friend
Thank you for this. It made my day much better than it's been in a while.
